title: Approval.
officialText:
Drinking fountains shall conform to ASME A112.19.1M, ASME A112.19.2M or ASME A112.19.9M, and water
coolers shall conform to ARI 1010. Drinking fountains and water coolers shall conform to NSF 61, Section 9. Drinking fountains
required by Table 403.1 shall be equipped with both a bubbler faucet for drinking and a separate faucet designed for filling a
container at least 10 inches (254 mm) in height.
